judgement.impact: Screen-reader user hears only generic 'image' and cannot learn about the 50% OFF TODAY promotion that sighted users see.
The user hears 'Total:' with no value and cannot verify the final amount they will be charged before paying.
The user hears only generic Click here where sighted users see Terms and cannot know the link leads to the Terms they agree to by paying.
The user cannot know the card number field is flagged as invalid and will try to pay without correcting it.
Blind user hears Close instead of delete/trash and cannot know the button discards payment information and may trigger the wrong action.
User hears only generic Submit and cannot confirm at the point of action that the button will pay R1,249.
The screen-reader user hears only generic Button and cannot know it is the Pay with wallet option or choose that payment method.
